svg.title: dod — Definition of Done
svg.desc: The dod wordmark on the navy band of dod's pages, with its promise: plan the whole feature before it is built, then see how much of the work the plan foresaw. On the right, the signature chart: a dashed predicted line, a solid observed line that steps up at three numbered changes, and the verified work filling in underneath.
